situation: Deploying a low-precision model as a security/write agent boundary.
decision: Require a mandatory BF16-or-API-versus-quantized tool-use evaluation gate before any low-precision perception model becomes the security boundary; evaluate tool selection, arg construction, long chains, refusal.
reasoning_physics: A quantized model acting as a security boundary must be proven to preserve the exact behaviors that block misuse. Missing a refusal or misforming an argument under quant is a security-relevant failure, so gate on task-fidelity not perplexity.
